name: casein kinase 1 alpha 1
pathways: positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction

function.text: CSNK1A1 encodes casein kinase I isoform alpha. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and protein serine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and positive regulation of Rho protein signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
